documentation.content:
A catalog source hasn't synced in 45 minutes (sync-catalog runs every 15). The catalog index and search show that source's products as they were. The source is in the incident (source_key).

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#%C3%8Dndice-del-cat%C3%A1logo).

conditions.displayName: No successful sync of a source in 45 min
